notes.title: Slam and Roll: The New Arcade Hit from KaleidoGames
notes.notes:
You know Kaleidogames has a long history of creating arcade games. In the past, we focused on shmups, and while we loved them, we felt it was time to bring something new. We chose to blend elements from the best single-screen stage-clear games of the ’90s to create a fusion of retro and modern gaming.

Rest assured, we worked tirelessly over four years to bring you an incredible experience, designed especially for lovers of challenging gameplay.

Enough talk. We’re proud to present SLAM AND ROLL (now out from Early Access, Switch and XBOX).

Get the game now with the special discount: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2004960/Slam_and_Roll/

notes.title: Update to fix world 3 and reduce adverts.
notes.notes:
Beekyr (Vanilla) edition has just updated to 1.3.18.
